description: This file defines the public API for loading flatbuffer-serialized mobile modules in PyTorch, including functions for parsing, loading, and extracting module information from raw bytes, files, and streams.

methods.name: parse_and_initialize_mobile_module
methods.description: Parses a mobile::Module from raw bytes without taking ownership of data, with options for device, extra files, and tensor memory copying.

methods.name: parse_and_initialize_mobile_module
methods.description: Parses a mobile::Module from shared pointer data, with options for device and extra files.

methods.name: parse_and_initialize_mobile_module_for_jit
methods.description: Parses a mobile::Module from raw bytes and extracts JIT source files and constants.

methods.name: load_mobile_module_from_file
methods.description: Loads a mobile::Module from a file path, with optional device and extra files.

methods.name: get_bytecode_version
methods.description: Retrieves bytecode version from an input stream.

methods.name: get_bytecode_version
methods.description: Retrieves bytecode version from a filename.

methods.name: get_bytecode_version_from_bytes
methods.description: Retrieves bytecode version from raw flatbuffer content bytes.

methods.name: get_module_info_from_flatbuffer
methods.description: Extracts module information from flatbuffer content.

methods.name: load_mobile_module_from_stream_with_copy
methods.description: Loads a mobile::Module from an input stream, copying the entire stream into a buffer.

methods.name: parse_flatbuffer_no_object
methods.description: Parses a flatbuffer into a mobile::Module without creating an object, using shared pointer data.

methods.name: register_flatbuffer_loader
methods.description: Registers the flatbuffer loader, currently a no-op.
